_note: UK employee deductions by tax year, used by `offer.py uk`. Copied from HMRC's published rates for employers. Add a new year when HMRC publishes it (usually in the spring before 6 April). Bands are on TAXABLE income (after the personal allowance), except the personal allowance taper, which starts at 100,000 of adjusted net income and removes 1 for every 2 above it.

2026-27.source: HMRC, Rates and thresholds for employers 2026 to 2027
